links.outcome: Erroneous and correct autonomous decisions (safety versus autonomy)
links.effect: The three-action policy rescued some erroneous autonomous decisions but also removed some correct ones. No counts are given in the text.
links.tradeoff: Lost autonomy: some correct autonomous decisions were removed. The abstract says the policy was not uniformly improved.
links.quote: These results show that separating information acquisition from clinician deferral exposes behavior that binary abstention hides, without yielding a uniformly improved decision policy.
